name: reuse-rerequest-receipt-snapshot
title: Reuse one current-head receipt snapshot during same-head rerequests (A-015)
description: Close audit finding A-015: a same-head rerequest begin loads the current-head elected receipt set twice before create -- once in #validateRerequest (via query) and again in #recordForIdentity -- duplicating listCheckRuns latency and GitHub quota. Load one pre-create snapshot and share it across rerequest validation and identity lookup; the post-create reread stays.
creator: sdelmas
